turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
differently. Here’s the scoop 👇

If an item arrived damaged, we need you to submit it through our help center contact form with:

photos of the damage
your order number
a short description of what happened

That’s because our team needs to document damage issues with the shipping partner before they process the replacement.

A normal return doesn’t follow that damage-report flow.

If you want, I can help you figure out exactly what to include in the message 🙂
